seed_policy: Take the first seven hex digits of SHA-256 of UTF-8 'proof-study-v1/{id}/{round}', in base 16. Use round 1 for first attempts and 2 for A, B and C.
system: Write for an undergraduate real analysis reader. Justify every material step, including the hypotheses of any theorem you invoke. Put the complete standalone proof between <proof> and </proof>. If you discuss an earlier attempt, put that discussion before <proof>. If you retain a proof, reproduce it in full. Inside the tags give only the mathematics.
A: Check your previous proof step by step. If you find an error or a gap, write a complete corrected proof. If the proof is valid, retain it.
B: This proof has been marked incorrect. Identify any errors or gaps and write a complete corrected proof.
